name: What are the common signs of a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a slab leak include unexplained increases in your water bill, warm spots on your floor, the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use, visible cracks in the foundation or walls, and damp or stained carpets or flooring. You might also notice a decrease in water pressure or feel areas of your floor that are unusually cold or hot. Musty odors or the presence of mold can also indicate a hidden leak beneath the slab. If you notice any of these signs, it's advisable to seek professional inspection.
